question_entry.question: How are firm expenses and dividends funded and calculated, and what happens to a failing firm, its shares and workshops?

key_entry.expected_answer: Start Revenue firms act initiative order then others, ties manager windows then PM clockwise. Expenses £1 per ship plus max(shares, firm value); either treasury. If cannot pay dissolution (or emergency rescue): shares Debtors Prison -1 VP each, ships shipyards, charter family, invested workshops stay invested. Dividends only India, £1 per share plus £1 manager each; shareholder may forgo with manager consent. Record total paid retirement marker then sweep remainder India to London.

If expenses unpaid firm dissolves unless rescued, shares move to Debtor's Prison at -1 VP each, ships to matching yards, charter to family side and invested workshops remain invested
Dividends use India treasury only and pay £1 per share plus £1 manager per dividend
Shareholder may forgo own dividends with manager consent
contextual_key_extras: Exact Revenue initiative order and its manager-windows/PM tiebreakers are contextual to this question about funding, calculation and dissolution.
Emergency rescue mechanisms are separately asked in Q067–Q068.

Recording total actual dividends on the retirement marker and sweeping remaining India cash to London are correct lifecycle context, beyond the specifically asked funding/calculation/dissolution clauses. Q060/Q066 ask marker use and exception, Q061 asks the sweep.

reader_a_entry.answer: Before Company expenses, firms pay in initiative order then others; ties by manager’s most windows, then PM clockwise. Expense £1 per charter ship plus higher of share count or firm value; London and/or India treasuries may pay. If unable, dissolve unless rescued by emergency investment or one-firm emergency merger. Dissolution sends shares to Debtor’s Prison (−1 VP each), ships to shipyards, charter to family side; workshops stay invested. After expenses manager may pay dividends only from India: each dividend £1/share plus £1 manager. Waiver requires both shareholder choice and manager consent. Record total actual cash paid on Balance track; active non-Hobnob paying none records zero; Hobnob keeps old marker. Sweep remaining India money to London.

evidence.quote: Pay £1 per charter ship plus higher of share count or firm value; can use either/both treasuries.

reader_b_entry.answer: Expense £1/charter ship + higher share count/value; either treasury. Insolvent dissolves (shares Prison −1 VP, ships to yards, charter flips; workshops stay invested) unless emergency investment or merger rescue. Merger one other firm, consent all; rescuing firm pays own expenses first, then endangered. Dividends from India: £1/share + £1 manager; waivers need shareholder and manager consent. Record actual payout; India remainder to London; Hobnob still expenses, retains marker.
